scenario.description: Patient requests early refill before allowed date.
scenario.goal: Agent explains policy and offers appropriate next step.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I need my Adderall refill two weeks early, I'm traveling.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Controlled substances can't be refilled early. Your next eligible date is the 15th.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Can the doctor approve an exception?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can send a message to your provider to review. Expect a call within 48 hours.
